## Exercises

1. With `d=16` and `H=2`, which columns of `q` does head 1 read?
2. Why is `attended` allocated with `np.empty_like(x)` instead of zeros?

<details>
<summary>Show answers and reasoning</summary>

1. Columns 8 to 15 (`slice(8, 16)`): every column belongs to exactly one head, and the split is contiguous.
2. Every cell of `attended` is written exactly once by the loop (each `(b, h)` pair writes its slice for all positions); no cell is read before being written, so zero-initialization would be wasted work.
</details>
